about.title: A construction and design firm based in Butwal.
paragraphs: ABS Builder's designs and builds houses, commercial buildings, public infrastructure and interiors in Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Nawalparasi and Dang.

Engineers, architects and interior designers work as one team, so drawings, estimate and site work are prepared together. You sign one contract and have one point of contact from the first visit to handover.

highlights.title: One contract, one contact
highlights.text: Design, approvals, construction and interiors are handled by one team under a single agreement.

highlights.title: Estimate before work starts
highlights.text: You receive an itemised BOQ with quantities, rates and material specifications before you sign.

highlights.title: Supervised construction
highlights.text: A named site engineer supervises each project and sends weekly photo updates.

services.title: Engineering
services.description: Structural design and construction management for buildings, roads, bridges and culverts, designed to the Nepal National Building Code.

services.title: Architectural

features: Layouts planned for light and ventilation

services.title: Interiors
services.description: Space planning, joinery and finishing for homes, offices and showrooms, delivered by the team that builds the structure.

servicesSection.title: Design, engineering and construction under one contract.

process.title: How a project runs, from first visit to handover.

steps.title: Site visit and brief
steps.text: We visit your plot, record your requirements and budget, and explain the options. This visit is free.

steps.title: Survey and concept
steps.text: Plot survey and soil information, then concept layouts and 3D views for your approval.

steps.title: Drawings and approval
steps.text: Architectural and structural drawings are prepared and submitted to the municipality for approval.

steps.title: Estimate and contract
steps.text: You receive an itemised BOQ with material specifications, and a contract with milestone payments.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: A site engineer supervises daily work, materials are tested, and you receive weekly photo updates.

steps.title: Handover and warranty
steps.text: Final inspection, handover of as-built drawings, and the workmanship warranty stated in your contract.

whyUs.title: What you can verify before you sign.

items.title: Registered professionals
items.text: Structural drawings are prepared and signed by engineers registered with the Nepal Engineering Council.

items.title: Itemised estimate
items.text: A line-by-line BOQ with quantities, rates and material specifications, given before you sign.

items.title: Milestone payments
items.text: Payments are tied to completed and inspected stages of work, not to calendar dates.

items.title: Material testing
items.text: Concrete cube tests and rebar checks are recorded for each pour and shared with you.

items.title: Named site engineer
items.text: One engineer is responsible for your site and sends weekly photo updates.

items.title: Written warranty
items.text: Workmanship warranty terms are written into the contract.

cta.title: Want to see a site in progress?
cta.text: We can take you to a live project and put you in touch with past clients on request.

testimonials.title: What clients say about working with us.
testimonials.intro: Short video accounts from clients, followed by written feedback.

faqSection.title: Questions clients ask before starting.
faqSection.intro: If your question is not answered here, call us on the number below.

faqs.a: Yes. We visit plots in Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Nawalparasi and Dang free of charge, discuss your requirements and give an indicative estimate. A full itemised BOQ follows once the drawings are final.
Yes. We prepare the architectural and structural drawings, submit them to the municipality and follow up until approval is issued.

Cost depends on built-up area, structure, finishes and site conditions, so we do not quote a single rate per square foot. You receive an itemised BOQ with quantities, rates and material specifications before you sign.
A typical two-and-a-half-storey house takes 8 to 12 months from approval to handover. The schedule, with milestones, is written into the contract.

faqs.q: Can I hire you for design or interiors only?
faqs.a: Yes. Architectural design, structural design, supervision and interiors can each be contracted separately, or together as one turnkey project.
Payments are tied to completed and inspected stages of work, not to calendar dates. The schedule is written into the contract.
Workmanship warranty terms are stated in the contract. Ask us for the standard terms before you decide.

contact.title: Request a site visit.
contact.intro: Tell us about your plot and what you plan to build. We reply within one working day.
contact.formNote: We will call to confirm a convenient time. There is no charge or obligation.
